pages.text: Iron: sword 6, armour 15.$(br)I. Orichalcum (Hellas): sword 6.5, armour 16, toughness 1, durability 900. Reflection.
II. Bulat (Nav, ore deep below): sword 7.5, armour 20, toughness 2, durability 1700. Lifesteal and divine ward. Its pickaxe mines dark iron.

III. Dark iron (Jotunheim, needs a diamond or bulat pickaxe): sword 8.5, armour 20, toughness 3.5, durability 2400. Monster slaying and divine ward.$(br)The gifts of the bosses beat the metal of their world: kladenets 8.5, Surtr's sword 10.5, Mjolnir 12.5.
